name: theodoor
description: Theatrical pyrotechnics and synchronized visual displays: design, simulate, and orchestrate musically-aligned shows

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli programs && npm run build -w @theodoor/viz
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli programs && tsc --noEmit -p packages/viz
scripts.gallery: tsc -b packages/cli programs && node packages/cli/dist/index.js gallery --out docs/gallery
scripts.gallery:check: npm run gallery && git diff --exit-code -- docs/gallery
